PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__Meta.ConfigLabel: PainterlyNPR - Smart Fields - Line Run-out and Vignette
PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: How a Line run-out point lets lines run on past the paint: which classes take part and how far each runs; and the sheet's vignette, where the paint dissolves into the paper.

PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__RunOu.LineRunClassesNote: The last class a point's Lines let through
PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__RunOu.RunClassReachNote: Profiles run furthest, texture least - gently: a rail is often modelled Optional
PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__RunOu.UnaimedNote: For a caller that does not know its object: the pixel's stands in

PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__Vigne.Note: The sheet's vignette, in sheet millimetres from its bottom-left corner: where the paint dissolves into the paper. v0.5.2, Adam: the default views cut off too much of the lower context, so the paint fills more of the sheet's height (it was centred at 104 mm, 60-112 mm high, the foreground squeezed by 1.35: the paint was half gone 52 mm above the foot of the sheet, now about 24 mm). v0.8.3: the sheet is A3, 420 x 297 mm, so every length here grew with it (across by 1.4, up by 1.485): the same shape on the page, the paint half gone about 36 mm above the foot.
PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__Vigne.CentreMmNote: A touch below the middle of the 297 mm height, so the foreground gets the room the sky gave up (150, 94 on the 300 x 200 mm sheet)
PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__Vigne.HalfWidthMmNote: At Painted area 0 and 1 (92 and 170 on the 300 x 200 mm sheet)
PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__Vigne.HalfHeightMmNote: At Painted area 0 and 1: about 150 mm at the default 62% (66 and 122 on the 300 x 200 mm sheet)
PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__Vigne.ForegroundSqueezeNote: Below the centre the field is this much tighter: the foreground still goes to paper first, but only just, and never reaches the sheet's foot
PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__Vigne.FadeNote: Fully present inside the first, gone past the second, in the field's own radius
PainterlyNPR__SmartFields__Config__Vigne.RoughnessNote: How far the edge's noise pushes it in or out, at Edge irregularity 0 and 1
